_comment: Seed file. Agents append patterns here as they learn them; see memory-system.md for the schema and .claude/scripts/extract-patterns.sh for the extraction job.

patterns.name: Layered API: routes -> services -> repositories
patterns.description: Keep HTTP shaping, business rules and persistence in separate layers so rules can be tested without HTTP and storage can change without touching routes.
patterns.problem: Business rules written inside route handlers can only be tested through HTTP, and every storage change rewrites the routes.
patterns.solution: Routes validate and delegate; services own rules and throw typed errors; repositories are the only code that touches Prisma.
patterns.when_to_use: Any API with more than trivial CRUD.

anti_patterns.name: Mocking the database in integration tests
anti_patterns.why_it_fails: A mocked database agrees with whatever the code believes, so schema drift, constraint violations and cascade behaviour all pass in CI and fail in production.
anti_patterns.instead: Run PostgreSQL in Docker and truncate between tests (Article III).
